metadata.purpose: Read-only SDK capabilities that fill gaps in mcp_registry_get_post.json, added by hand because operator tooling depends on them.
metadata.live_validated: 2026-08-07, round-2 AI-consumption audit: all eight executed against a live tenant through read_capability and their semantic tools. Body schemas below were filled in from the request bodies the semantic tools actually send, which are the known-good forms. See tmp/findings/r2_curated.md.

type.description: Only 'anynet' is accepted. Note this is NOT the same vocabulary as get_topology's `view` argument - that tool's 'basenet' view is built from an 'anynet' query plus per-leg status calls.

actions.description: AnyNet topology query. Returns the full node/link graph in one object; prefer the get_topology tool, which pages it.

limit.description: Result cap and ordering, e.g. {"count": 100, "sort_on": "time", "sort_order": "descending"}. Max count is 100.

start_time.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-08-07T09:00:00.000Z. Optional; may be given without end_time.

end_time.description: ISO 8601. Optional; may be given without start_time.
ISO 8601. Must be supplied together with start_time.

filter.description: Scope filter; a site is effectively required, e.g. {"site": ["<site_id>"], "element": ["<element_id>"], "app": ["<app_id>"], "path": ["<path_id>"], "wan_interface": ["<waninterface_id>"]}.

page_size.description: Rows per page requested from the controller.

actions.description: Flow-monitoring query. Requires an explicit time window.
Bandwidth/system monitor metrics query over a time window.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 snapshot anchor - this is a point-in-time read, so there is no end_time. Must be in the past: an anchor at or after 'now' is rejected as a future timestamp. Step back at least one interval.

metrics.description: Series to fetch, e.g. [{"name": "LqmLatencyPointMetric", "unit": "milliseconds", "statistics": ["AVG"]}]. Also LqmPktLossPointMetric, LqmJitterPointMetric, LqmMosPointMetric.

actions.description: LQM (link quality) point metrics: latency/loss/jitter/MOS at one instant.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 snapshot anchor - this is a point-in-time read, so there is no end_time. Must be in the past: an anchor at or after 'now' is rejected as a future timestamp. Step back at least one interval.

metrics.description: Series to fetch, e.g. [{"name": "ProbeLatencyPointMetric", "unit": "milliseconds", "statistics": ["AVG", "MIN", "MAX"]}]. Also ProbeJitterPointMetric, ProbePktLossPointMetric.

actions.description: Synthetic probe point metrics at one instant.
Per-leg VPN link live status. vpnlink_id comes from get_topology's basenet view or get_wan(operation='vpn_links').
Per-leg VPN link administrative state. vpnlink_id comes from get_topology's basenet view or get_wan(operation='vpn_links').
